trigger.description: SRR6.46.3 auto-enrollment ran against a workspace that already carries a materialized peer group for the current tailnet. The pre-flight idempotency check refuses to re-materialize over an existing matching set; the code surfaces so the operator sees the no-op was intentional rather than a silent skip.
setup_commands: ee mesh auto-enroll --workspace . --json   # first run materializes the peer group
ee mesh auto-enroll --workspace . --json   # this run reports already-complete
